defects: Adds an explicit `Monotone f` hypothesis not present in the gold statement (even though it is implied by ord-continuity, it is an extra stated hypothesis, not part of the original proposition)

`hleft` pairs the sSup-preservation equation `f (sSup s) = sSup (f '' s)` with the condition `BddBelow s` instead of `BddAbove s`. In a conditionally complete lattice, `sSup s` only equals the genuine supremum when `s` is Nonempty and BddAbove; for sets that are BddBelow but not BddAbove, `sSup s` is an arbitrary junk value, so this hypothesis is not equivalent to `LeftOrdContinuous f` (which, via `IsLUB`, correctly corresponds to Nonempty+BddAbove sets) — it imposes extraneous, implementation/junk-dependent constraints instead

`hright` symmetrically pairs the sInf-preservation equation with `BddAbove s` instead of `BddBelow s`, the boundedness condition needed for `sInf s` to be meaningful, mismatching `RightOrdContinuous f` in the same way
Because of the swapped boundedness conditions, the produced hypotheses do not faithfully capture left/right order continuity, so mathematical equivalence to the gold statement cannot be confirmed
